review_type: independent manual code/source and guidance review
resolved_pre_freeze_finding: Initial citation lines:null could fall back to legacy locator text despite explicit-line contract. Worker fixed the shape guard before freeze and retained a regression test.

findings.finding: The new module is the only runtime-source addition. Existing runtime sources, PX2 specification/registry and lifecycle/decision/family meanings are unchanged. The utility adds no UDL record, caller-result schema mutation, provider action or acceptance event.

Inventory derives every scalar/empty-container leaf from explicitly selected disjoint saved-result subtrees independently of review rows. JSON pointer escaping, typed literal values, duplicate/finite JSON, overlap and stale-result identity are explicitly handled.

Coverage reports distinguish absent, duplicated, unexpected, changed and incomplete claims plus stale result/scope/source/carrier bindings. Metadata is explicitly reviewer-classified and separately enumerated. All statuses preserve semantic_verdict not_assessed; coverage cannot certify source support or authority.

The observed lines:null legacy-locator loophole is fixed: citations require an explicit list, then the unchanged source resolver rejects malformed or out-of-bounds integer ranges. Carrier excerpts compare exact text including line endings; the bounded resolver requires narrower ranges when needed.

Input, source and optional output paths use existing root confinement. The API reads only; CLI output is one exclusive fresh file. Existing result/review/source/report bytes are not overwritten. Direct copied launcher sets dont_write_bytecode before runtime imports and selects its own relocated runtime.

Guidance requires whole question and authored next-operation subtrees, actual final result binding, every leaf reviewed, and all current operational excerpts declared. It explicitly acknowledges that unlisted prose, metadata classification and source meaning remain outside automatic coverage.

Current operational instructions belong in a self-contained new section. Old operational notes remain history/evidence even when linked by section; the new section cannot supersede primary owner requirements or source criteria. Existing authorization and independent useful work continue without a new human permission gate.

Authored explanations remain separate from unchanged runtime-derived continuation. Product guidance contains no retained fixture-specific answers and requires final semantic rereading even after complete coverage. Review/report hashes are returned alongside their bound result to avoid circular identity.

The final test source addresses omitted later questions, stale/type/metadata/carrier cases, malformed JSON and paths, real link/junction escape, input bytes/mtime preservation, and relocated -I execution without caches. Existing focused test evidence is bound separately; this review did not rerun the product tests.

prior_test_attempt_preserved: tool-development-01/checks-01 retains initial lint failure and Windows symlink skip; checks-02 uses a real junction fallback without skip.
limits: Static source review, not a new full suite or native-behavior result.
